scope: Regular and Italic; Russian, Kazakh and inherited Latin

decisions.item: Italic constructed letters lack mark anchors; add native-compatible anchors.
Regular homoglyph GLIF roundtrip loses hint programs; clone declared native glyphs.
Italic zhe counters shortened by up to 48 units per bowl; gaps 45 to 32; no uniform scaling.
Keep the author-selected rounded Cormorant-derived Regular de, and its printed ss07 alternative.
No claim of complete Bulgarian/Serbian/Ukrainian support; language expansion and small caps remain separate work.
Both styles share a release version; internal italic drawing revision remains I027.
Regular de bowl and width retained; smooth displacement below -10 shortens loop -280 to -250; printed ss07 unchanged.
Additional kern/calt lookups must ignore combining marks; stress-word spacing regression added.
Add Bulgarian stressed i characters Ѝ/ѝ without claiming full local-form review.

Remove visible notches in italic ж and upper shoulder kink of з. ж: remove k branch stubs; redraw clean stem with native weight; correct bowl shoulder tangent. з: outgoing handle y487 to489; contour deviation ~1 unit. Per-glyph assertions and enlarged proof.
Default italic г: exact native dotlessi body from locl SRB imacron, without uni0304. Preserve SRB/MKD macron and printed ss04; retain previous construction source and 1.100 archive.

optical_acceptance.scope: Default italic ghe selected by author: Serbian body without the macron
viewed: final ghe comparison, old/default/Serbian local form
Russian and Kazakh ghe word samples with final kerning
decisions: Accept exact native dotlessi body and metrics (375 to 288 units).
Retain native stroke weight and endpoints; remove only the separate macron from the selected construction.
locl SRB/MKD and printed ss04 pass explicit shaping checks.
All other outlines, hint programs and advance/sidebearing metrics match accepted 1.100 byte for byte, as recorded in docs/qa/ghe-1.101.json.
limitations: Linux browser checks only; native Windows/macOS/commercial-app and physical print tests are not claimed.

viewed: Russian and Kazakh words, both styles
all stylistic sets and SRB/MKD local forms
12/24/100 pt on light and dark backgrounds
enlarged final exported zhe and ze joins
decisions: Regular rounded de retained with shorter loop; no new triangular construction.
Italic zhe now follows surrounding lowercase proportions; protected bowl spines and terminals retain their stroke weight.
Stem nicks and bowl shoulder of italic zhe corrected; ze upper shoulder is smooth at the exported quadratic contour.
Author tails, Kazakh letter distinctions, handwritten Cyrillic and native Latin retained.
Inherited native ogonek contours and intentional italic ka loop are accepted; contour counts alone do not justify changing the design.
limitations: No native Windows/macOS or commercial-app test
Display typeface; no small-text optical master promised

diagnostic_spots_reviewed.result: Retained after enlarged inspection; native pen transitions and intentional counter corners are not forced into zero-angle joins. No new diagnostics relative to baseline, except exact native-copy restoration.
